    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">salesforce零基础学习（一百四十五）Apex API 66以后 运行为 User Mode</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>&nbsp;<strong>背景</strong></p>
<p>此前我们的经验中，apex代码一直运行在system mode中，但是当summer'26 release（即apex api version： 67）以后，apex将运行在 user mode，所以以后创建apex class的时候，也需要严格的检查当前系统设置默认生成的api version。否则程序中会出现到意想不到的结果。</p>
<p>此前我们的博客解释过 System Mode以及User Mode，这里一句话进行总结：</p>
<p>User Mode（用户模式）: 按当前运行用户的权限执行，会检查对象权限（CRUD）、字段安全（FLS）以及共享规则（sharing）；</p>
<p>System Mode（系统模式）：不检查当前用户的对象权限以及FLS，相当于用户拥有所有对象和字段的访问权。记录级共享是否生效，要看apex class声明的sharing关键字。</p>
<p>那么 api version 66及以前和以后都有哪些明显的区别呢，我们按照以下的demo可以更好的了解：</p>
<p><strong>测试举例, 由AI生成</strong></p>
<p><strong>1. </strong>创建一个自定义表，包含两个字段，其中一个有FLS，一个没有FLS</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/910966/202611/910966-20261107225823834-1662894811.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2.&nbsp;&nbsp;AccessModeDemoController，主要实现三个功能：</p>
<ul>
<li>展示当前用户信息权限</li>
<li>通过前端按钮进行不同的路由，执行 system mode和 user mode</li>
<li>对查询所有的场景进行测试</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
 * Apex 用户模式 / 系统模式对比演示（LWC 控制器）。
 *
 * 外层类声明为 with sharing；需要绕过记录共享的场景放在内部 without sharing 类 Elevated 中，
 * 以便同时演示：访问模式（CRUD/FLS）与 sharing 关键字（记录级）是两套独立的机制。
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> with sharing <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AccessModeDemoController {

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> String NOT_RETURNED = '— 未返回 —'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> String DEMO_FIELDS = 'Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> List&lt;String&gt; DEMO_PATHS = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;String&gt;{ 'Name', 'Public_Note__c', 'Secret_Note__c', 'Owner.Name'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> List&lt;String&gt; DEMO_PUBLIC_PATHS = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;String&gt;{ 'Name', 'Public_Note__c', 'Owner.Name'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------------- DTO</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScenarioResult {
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String key;

        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String sharing;
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String codeSnippet;
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String explanation;
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Boolean success = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Integer rowCount;
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> List&lt;Map&lt;String, String&gt;&gt; columns = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;Map&lt;String, String&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> List&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; rows = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String errorType;
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String errorMessage;

    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserContext {
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String userId;
        @AuraEnabled </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String userName;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------------- 内部 without sharing 类</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> without sharing <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Elevated {
        List</span>&lt;Access_Mode_Demo__c&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> querySystemMode() {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name
                    FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH SYSTEM_MODE ORDER BY CreatedDate];
        }
        Integer countAll() {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Database.countQuery('SELECT COUNT() FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE);
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> insertAsSystem(Access_Mode_Demo__c rec) {
            insert as system rec;
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------------- 当前用户上下文</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    @AuraEnabled
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserContext getUserContext() {
        Id uid </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserInfo.getUserId();
        UserContext ctx </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserContext();
        ctx.userId </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> uid;
        ctx.userName </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserInfo.getName();
        ctx.loginName </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserInfo.getUserName();
        User me </span>= [SELECT Profile.Name FROM User WHERE Id =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> :uid WITH SYSTEM_MODE];
        ctx.profileName </span>= me.Profile?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Name;
        ctx.modifyAllData </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [SELECT COUNT() FROM PermissionSetAssignment
                             WHERE AssigneeId </span>= :uid AND PermissionSet.PermissionsModifyAllData = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                             WITH SYSTEM_MODE] </span>&gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        ctx.canCreateDemo </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Schema.SObjectType.Access_Mode_Demo__c.isCreateable();
        ctx.canReadSecret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Schema.SObjectType.Access_Mode_Demo__c.fields.Secret_Note__c.isAccessible();
        ctx.totalDemoRecords </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Elevated().countAll();
        ctx.ownDemoRecords </span>= [SELECT COUNT() FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WHERE OwnerId =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> :uid WITH SYSTEM_MODE];
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ctx;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------------- 查询对比场景</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    @AuraEnabled
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> List&lt;ScenarioResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> runAllScenarios() {
        List</span>&lt;ScenarioResult&gt; results = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;ScenarioResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> A. 未声明访问模式 · 类 API 66.0</span>
        ScenarioResult a = newResult('A', '默认模式', '未声明访问模式（类 API 66.0）', '默认（系统）', 'without sharing'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'// AccessModeDefaultV66.cls  (apiVersion 66.0)\n[SELECT ' + DEMO_FIELDS + ' FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c]'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'API 66.0 及以前默认系统模式：不检查当前用户的对象权限和 FLS；without sharing 也不按共享过滤。'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            fill(a, AccessModeDefaultV66.queryWithoutModeClause(), DEMO_PATHS);
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e) { fail(a, e); }
        results.add(a);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> B. 未声明访问模式 · 类 API 68.0</span>
        ScenarioResult b = newResult('B', '默认模式', '未声明访问模式（类 API 68.0）', '默认（用户）', 'without sharing'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'// AccessModeDefaultV68.cls  (apiVersion 68.0)\n[SELECT ' + DEMO_FIELDS + ' FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c]'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'API 67.0 及以后默认用户模式：同样的代码，仅因类的 API 版本不同，就会检查 CRUD、FLS 和共享。'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            fill(b, AccessModeDefaultV68.queryWithoutModeClause(), DEMO_PATHS);
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e) { fail(b, e); }
        results.add(b);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> C. WITH USER_MODE（包含受限字段）</span>
        ScenarioResult c = newResult('C', '显式声明', 'WITH USER_MODE（包含 Secret_Note__c）', '用户模式', 'with sharing'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'[SELECT ' + DEMO_FIELDS + ' FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH USER_MODE]'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'用户模式检查 FLS：用户没有 Secret_Note__c 读取权限时整条查询抛 QueryException，可用 getInaccessibleFields() 拿到全部无权限字段。'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            fill(c, [SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name
                     FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH USER_MODE ORDER BY CreatedDate], DEMO_PATHS);
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e) { fail(c, e); }
        results.add(c);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> D. WITH USER_MODE（仅有权限字段）</span>
        ScenarioResult d = newResult('D', '显式声明', 'WITH USER_MODE（仅查询有权限字段）', '用户模式', 'with sharing'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'[SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Owner.Name FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH USER_MODE]'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'用户模式始终遵守共享规则：OWD 为 Private 时，普通用户只能看到自己拥有或被共享的记录。'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            fill(d, [SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Owner.Name
                     FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH USER_MODE ORDER BY CreatedDate], DEMO_PUBLIC_PATHS);
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e) { fail(d, e); }
        results.add(d);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> E. WITH SYSTEM_MODE + without sharing</span>
        ScenarioResult e1 = newResult('E', '显式声明', 'WITH SYSTEM_MODE + without sharing', '系统模式', 'without sharing'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'private without sharing class Elevated {\n  [SELECT ' + DEMO_FIELDS + ' FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH SYSTEM_MODE]\n}'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'系统模式不检查 CRUD/FLS；类为 without sharing，因此也不按共享过滤 —— 能看到全部记录和 Secret_Note__c。'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            fill(e1, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Elevated().querySystemMode(), DEMO_PATHS);
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e) { fail(e1, e); }
        results.add(e1);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> F. WITH SYSTEM_MODE + with sharing</span>
        ScenarioResult f = newResult('F', '显式声明', 'WITH SYSTEM_MODE + with sharing', '系统模式', 'with sharing'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'public with sharing class AccessModeDemoController {\n  [SELECT ' + DEMO_FIELDS + ' FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH SYSTEM_MODE]\n}'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'系统模式下记录可见性由类的 sharing 关键字决定：with sharing 仍按共享过滤行，但 FLS 不检查，Secret_Note__c 照样返回。'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            fill(f, [SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name
                     FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH SYSTEM_MODE ORDER BY CreatedDate], DEMO_PATHS);
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e) { fail(f, e); }
        results.add(f);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> G. Security.stripInaccessible</span>
        ScenarioResult g = newResult('G', '优雅降级', 'Security.stripInaccessible(READABLE)', '系统模式查询 + 剥离', 'with sharing'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'List&lt;Access_Mode_Demo__c&gt; recs = [SELECT ... FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH SYSTEM_MODE];\n'
                + 'SObjectAccessDecision dec = Security.stripInaccessible(AccessType.READABLE, recs);\n'
                + 'dec.getRecords(); dec.getRemovedFields();'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span>'不抛异常，而是把当前用户无权读取的字段从结果里移除；getRemovedFields() 返回被移除的字段。'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            List</span>&lt;Access_Mode_Demo__c&gt; raw =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name
                                             FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH SYSTEM_MODE ORDER BY CreatedDate];
            SObjectAccessDecision dec </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Security.stripInaccessible(AccessType.READABLE, raw);
            fill(g, dec.getRecords(), DEMO_PATHS);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (String obj : dec.getRemovedFields().keySet()) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (String fld : dec.getRemovedFields().get(obj)) {
                    g.problemFields.add(obj </span>+ '.' +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fld);
                }
            }
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e) { fail(g, e); }
        results.add(g);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> results;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------------- DML 对比场景</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    @AuraEnabled
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScenarioResult createRecord(String name, String publicNote, String secretNote, String mode) {
        Boolean asUser </span>= (mode == 'USER'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ScenarioResult r </span>= newResult(asUser ? 'DML_USER' : 'DML_SYSTEM', 'DML'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            asUser </span>? 'insert as user' : 'insert as system'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            asUser </span>? '用户模式' : '系统模式', asUser ? 'with sharing' : 'without sharing'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            asUser </span>? 'insert as user rec;' : 'insert as system rec;  // 在 without sharing 内部类中执行'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            asUser
                </span>? '用户模式 DML 检查对象“新建”权限与字段编辑 FLS。本 demo 实测：缺少对象新建权限时抛 System.TypeException（DML operation INSERT not allowed）；官方文档说明 FLS 错误可通过 DmlException.getDmlFieldNames() 获取。'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                : </span>'系统模式 DML 不检查当前用户的 CRUD/FLS，即使用户没有“新建”权限也能写入。'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        Access_Mode_Demo__c rec </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Access_Mode_Demo__c(
            Name </span>= String.isBlank(name) ? 'Demo ' + System.now().format('HH:mm:ss'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) : name,
            Public_Note__c </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> publicNote,
            Secret_Note__c </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> secretNote);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (asUser) {
                insert as user rec;
            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Elevated().insertAsSystem(rec);
            }
            r.success </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            r.rowCount </span>= 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            Access_Mode_Demo__c saved </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name
                                         FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WHERE Id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> :rec.Id WITH SYSTEM_MODE];
            fill(r, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;SObject&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{ saved }, DEMO_PATHS);
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e) {
            fail(r, e);
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScenarioResult newResult(String key, String grp, String title, String mode, String sharing,
                                            String code, String explanation) {
        ScenarioResult r </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScenarioResult();
        r.key </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> key;
        r.category </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> grp;
        r.title </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> title;
        r.mode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mode;
        r.sharing </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sharing;
        r.codeSnippet </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> code;
        r.explanation </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> explanation;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> fill(ScenarioResult r, List&lt;SObject&gt; recs, List&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> paths) {
        r.success </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        r.rowCount </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> recs.size();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (String p : paths) {
            r.columns.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Map&lt;String, String&gt;{ 'label' =&gt; p, 'fieldName' =&gt; p.replace('.', '_'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) });
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (SObject rec : recs) {
            Map</span>&lt;String, Object&gt; row = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Map&lt;String, Object&gt;{ 'Id' =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rec.Id };
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (String p : paths) {
                row.put(p.replace(</span>'.', '_'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), readPath(rec, p));
            }
            r.rows.add(row);
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fail(ScenarioResult r, Exception e) {
        r.success </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        r.errorType </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.getTypeName();
        r.errorMessage </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.getMessage();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (e <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">instanceof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QueryException) {
            Map</span>&lt;String, Set&lt;String&gt;&gt; inaccessible =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ((QueryException) e).getInaccessibleFields();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (inaccessible != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (String obj : inaccessible.keySet()) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (String fld : inaccessible.get(obj)) {
                        r.problemFields.add(obj </span>+ '.' +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fld);
                    }
                }
            }
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (e <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">instanceof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DmlException) {
            DmlException de </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (DmlException) e;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (Integer i = 0; i &lt; de.getNumDml(); i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                List</span>&lt;String&gt; names =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> de.getDmlFieldNames(i);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (names != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                    r.problemFields.addAll(names);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Object readPath(SObject rec, String path) {
        Map</span>&lt;String, Object&gt; populated =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rec.getPopulatedFieldsAsMap();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!path.contains('.'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">populated.containsKey(path)) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NOT_RETURNED;
            }
            Object v </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> populated.get(path);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> v == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> ? '(空值)'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> : String.valueOf(v);
        }
        String rel </span>= path.substringBefore('.'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!populated.containsKey(rel) || populated.get(rel) == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NOT_RETURNED;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> readPath(rec.getSObject(rel), path.substringAfter('.'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
    }
}</span></pre>

                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="slds-text-color_weak"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>点击右上角“运行全部对比场景”。<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lightning-card</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<div>AccessModeDemo.js</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">import { LightningElement } from 'lwc';
import getUserContext from '@salesforce/apex/AccessModeDemoController.getUserContext';
import runAllScenarios from '@salesforce/apex/AccessModeDemoController.runAllScenarios';
import createRecord from '@salesforce/apex/AccessModeDemoController.createRecord';

const yesNo = (v) =&gt; (v ? '有' : '无');
const badge = (v) =&gt; `slds-badge ${v ? 'slds-theme_success' : 'slds-theme_error'}`;

export default class AccessModeDemo extends LightningElement {
    ctx;
    error;
    busy = false;
    results = [];
    dmlResult;
    lastRunAt;
    newName = '';
    newPublic = '公开备注';
    newSecret = '机密备注';

    connectedCallback() {
        this.loadContext();
    }

    async loadContext() {
        try {
            this.ctx = await getUserContext();
        } catch (e) {
            this.error = this.reduceError(e);
        }
    }

    get modifyAllText() { return yesNo(this.ctx?.modifyAllData); }
    get modifyAllClass() { return badge(this.ctx?.modifyAllData); }
    get canCreateText() { return yesNo(this.ctx?.canCreateDemo); }
    get canCreateClass() { return badge(this.ctx?.canCreateDemo); }
    get canReadSecretText() { return yesNo(this.ctx?.canReadSecret); }
    get canReadSecretClass() { return badge(this.ctx?.canReadSecret); }

    get hasResults() {
        return this.results &amp;&amp; this.results.length &gt; 0;
    }

    get summaryRows() {
        return this.results.map((r) =&gt; ({
            key: r.key,
            title: r.title,
            mode: r.mode,
            sharing: r.sharing,
            statusText: r.success ? `成功 · ${r.rowCount} 行` : `失败 · ${r.errorType}`,
            statusClass: badge(r.success),
            problemText: (r.problemFields || []).join(', ')
        }));
    }

    handleInput(event) {
        this[event.target.dataset.field] = event.target.value;
    }

    async handleCreate(event) {
        const mode = event.target.dataset.mode;
        this.busy = true;
        this.error = undefined;
        try {
            this.dmlResult = await createRecord({
                name: this.newName,
                publicNote: this.newPublic,
                secretNote: this.newSecret,
                mode
            });
            await this.loadContext();
        } catch (e) {
            this.error = this.reduceError(e);
        } finally {
            this.busy = false;
        }
    }

    async handleRunAll() {
        this.busy = true;
        this.error = undefined;
        try {
            this.results = await runAllScenarios();
            this.lastRunAt = new Date().toLocaleString();
        } catch (e) {
            this.error = this.reduceError(e);
        } finally {
            this.busy = false;
        }
    }

    reduceError(e) {
        return e?.body?.message || e?.message || JSON.stringify(e);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>6. 创建普通用户：没有 Access_Mode_Demo的创建权限，没有Secret_Note__c的读取权限。</p>
<p><strong>测试结果展示：</strong></p>
<p><strong>一. DML 场景</strong></p>
<p>1. 点击用户模式新建，因为走 User Mode，所以报错：DML operation INSERT not allowed on Access_Mode_Demo__c。</p>
<p>后台的DML主要执行insert as user rec;//rec为这条Access_Mode_Demo的记录</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/910966/202611/910966-20261107220935614-487079016.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2. 添加permission set，允许 Access_Mode_Demo__c新建权限，点击用户模式新建，因为走 User Mode，所以报错：<span>System.DmlException：Operation failed due to fields being inaccessible on Sobject Access_Mode_Demo__c, check errors on Exception or Result!</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/910966/202611/910966-20261107223813108-2091886327.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;3.&nbsp;点击系统模式新建，因为走 System Mode，所以创建成功。</p>
<p>后台的DML主要执行insert as system rec;//rec为这条Access_Mode_Demo的记录</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/910966/202611/910966-20261107221230813-1691431078.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;二. 查询场景</strong></p>
<p>查询场景主要包含了以下的组合。通过下图的排列组合可以看到，当在api version是 68.0时，由于走 User Mode, 当SOQL中对某个字段没有查询权限时，会报错。System.QueryException，</p>
<table border="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>场景</td>
<td>访问模式</td>
<td>sharing</td>
<td>SOQL</td>
<td>结果</td>
<td>问题字段</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>未声明访问模式（类 API 66.0）</td>
<td>系统模式</td>
<td>Without Sharing</td>
<td>
<div>
<div>SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name</div>
<div>FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c ORDER BY CreatedDate</div>
</div>
</td>
<td>成功</td>
<td>&nbsp;</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>未声明访问模式（类 API 68.0）</td>
<td>用户模式</td>
<td>Without Sharing</td>
<td>
<div>SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name</div>
<div>FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c ORDER BY CreatedDate</div>
</td>
<td>失败 · System.QueryException</td>
<td>Access_Mode_Demo__c.Secret_Note__c</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>WITH USER_MODE（包含 Secret_Note__c；类 API 68.0）</td>
<td>用户模式</td>
<td>With Sharing</td>
<td>
<div>
<div>SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name</div>
<div>FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH USER_MODE ORDER BY CreatedDate</div>
</div>
</td>
<td>失败 · System.QueryException</td>
<td>Access_Mode_Demo__c.Secret_Note__c</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>WITH USER_MODE（仅查询有权限字段；类 API 68.0）</td>
<td>用户模式</td>
<td>With Sharing</td>
<td>
<div>
<div>SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Owner.Name</div>
<div>FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH USER_MODE ORDER BY CreatedDate</div>
</div>
</td>
<td>成功</td>
<td>&nbsp;</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>WITH SYSTEM_MODE + without sharing（类 API 68.0）</td>
<td>系统模式</td>
<td>Without Sharing</td>
<td>
<div>
<div>SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name</div>
<div>FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH SYSTEM_MODE ORDER BY CreatedDate</div>
</div>
</td>
<td>成功</td>
<td>&nbsp;</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>WITH SYSTEM_MODE + with sharing（类 API 68.0）</td>
<td>系统模式</td>
<td>With Sharing</td>
<td>
<div>SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name</div>
<div>FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH SYSTEM_MODE ORDER BY CreatedDate</div>
</td>
<td>成功</td>
<td>&nbsp;</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Security.stripInaccessible(类 API 68.0)</td>
<td>系统模式查询 + 无权限字段移除</td>
<td>With Sharing</td>
<td>
<div>
<div>List&lt;Access_Mode_Demo__c&gt; raw = [SELECT Id, Name, Public_Note__c, Secret_Note__c, Owner.Name</div>
<div>FROM Access_Mode_Demo__c WITH SYSTEM_MODE ORDER BY CreatedDate];</div>
<div>SObjectAccessDecision dec = Security.stripInaccessible(AccessType.READABLE, raw);</div>
</div>
</td>
<td>成功</td>
<td>结果集中，返回的结果将不会包含Secret_Note__c</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>总结：</strong></p>
<p>AI时代，Salesforce对于安全性看得越来越重要，所以最近的release增强了很多的安全的更新。 如果你的项目中的代码对于权限的安全性要求很高，你可以考虑user mode或者使用 system mode 搭配stripInaccessible方法实现基于用户级别的权限访问和操作，把数据操作控制在最小范围。后续创建apex前，也思考一下你的项目架构中适用于system mode还是 user mode运行，不同的场景使用不同的api version（66及以前 / 66以后）。</p>
<p><strong>参考文档：</strong></p>
<p>https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/apex-dev/references/apex-dev/apex-classes-enforce-usermode.html</p>
<p>https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/apex-dev/references/apex-dev/apex-classes-with-security-stripinaccessible.html</p>
